newsitem.title: UK: Wolseley slips after Merrill downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Wolseley slips after Merrill downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Wolseley Plc slipped on Wednesday after brokerage Merrill Lynch cut its earnings forecast for the international building supplies group.

Kevin Cammack at Merrill said he cut the pre-tax profit estimates for the year ending July 31, 1997 to 263 from 270 million stg. He also reduced his profit forecast for the next financial to 286 from 300 million stg.
By 1110 GMT the stock was down three pence at 468 pence.

The reduction of the forecasts reflected the slower than expected recovery of Britain's construction industry as well as the strong sterling which would affect its international business, Cammack said.
Cammack reiterated Wolseley was a "long-term buy" but rated it "neutral" in the short-term.
SBC Warburg which was said to have rated Wolseley a "sell" declined comment.
